releaseNotes: v1.5.48: Priority announcements system with multi-notice carousel, dedicated Notice Board, auto-expiry, and live read receipts. Seamless leading-app back navigation with zero accidental app exits. Hardened student profile photo updates.

organization.name: The Cozy Corner Study Centre
organization.address: Front Of Reliance Fashion Factory, Nath Road, Parli-431515

studentFeatures.title: Multi-Notice Carousel & Dedicated Notice Board
studentFeatures.description: Browse library announcements in a swipeable dashboard carousel with instant dismiss and view full historical circulars in the new Notice Board & Circulars hub.

studentFeatures.title: Smart Back Navigation & Zero Accidental Exits
studentFeatures.description: Pressing back from your Profile, Receipts, or Membership smoothly returns to your Home dashboard. Explicit back buttons added across all pages with double-tap exit protection.

studentFeatures.title: Real-Time Pass Validity & Dynamic Status
studentFeatures.description: Your digital student pass automatically updates to Active, Grace Period, or Expired based on your plan end date, with instant 1-tap renewal to retain your study seat.

studentFeatures.title: Dynamic Seat Radar & Change In Progress Tracking
studentFeatures.description: Your allocated desk card alerts you with clear guidance when your membership is in grace or expired, and tracks pending desk change requests in real time.

studentFeatures.title: Instant Profile Photo Upload & Hardened Permissions
studentFeatures.description: Updating your profile photo and details is now instant and error-free, backed by hardened cloud security rules.

adminFeatures.title: Priority Circulars, Auto-Expiry & Read Receipts
adminFeatures.description: Publish urgent, maintenance, or holiday circulars with auto-expiry dates, broadcast them to notifications, and see real-time student read counts.

adminFeatures.title: Dynamic Student Validity & Expiration Engine
adminFeatures.description: Student membership evaluation runs dynamically in real time. Expired passes are automatically flagged with instant check-in verification.

adminFeatures.title: Hardened Firestore Rules & Dynamic Attribution
adminFeatures.description: Fine-grained Firestore Security Rules allow student photo updates, seat changes, and personal notifications while maintaining strict zero-trust isolation.
